events.label: Наука
entries: 1831 – Michael Faraday discovers electromagnetic induction.
1949 – Soviet atomic bomb project: The Soviet Union tests its first atomic bomb, known as First Lightning or Joe 1, at Semipalatinsk, Kazakhstan.
1982 – Meitnerium, a synthetic chemical element with the atomic number 109, is first synthesized at the Gesellschaft für Schwerionenforschung in Darmstadt, Germany.

events.label: Искусство
entries: 1952 – American experimental composer John Cage's 4’33” premieres at Maverick Concert Hall, played by American pianist David Tudor.
1966 – The Beatles perform their last concert before paying fans at Candlestick Park in San Francisco.

events.label: Образование
entries: 1728 – The city of Nuuk in Greenland is founded as the fort of Godt-Haab by the royal governor Claus Paarss.
1898 – The Goodyear tire company is founded in Akron, Ohio.
1958 – United States Air Force Academy opens in Colorado Springs, Colorado.

events.label: Литература
entries: 1970 – Chicano Moratorium against the Vietnam War, East Los Angeles, California. Police riot kills three people, including journalist Rubén Salazar.
